title: Life Plan Member Rate for Assisted Living Apartment Transfers
content:
A Larkspur Life Plan member pays a reduced apartment transfer fee under the Assisted Living Residency and Care Agreement:

| Customer's Entrance Fee Agreement | Share of the transfer fee |
|---|---|
| In occupied status, under a lifecare plan | 0.5 |
| In occupied status, under any other plan | 0.75 |
| No Entrance Fee Agreement in occupied status | No reduction under this bulletin |

The plan is the one the occupied Entrance Fee Agreement is under; whether it is a lifecare plan is set by that plan's contract type in the Entrance Fee Agreement terms. The share multiplies the transfer fee before it is rounded once to the cent.

**Illustration (hypothetical).** On a fee of 650.00 alone, a lifecare plan member pays 325.00 and a member under any other plan pays 487.50.
